given_when_then.given: A Customer Profile exists with a unique identifier and verified contact details
given_when_then.when: The account closure or significant status change event is triggered by the Platform Operator or Store Partner
given_when_then.then: The system archives the Customer Profile and retains all historical data including associated Order Requests and Financial Transaction Records without modification

given_when_then.given: An actor attempts to modify an archived Customer Profile after the archival action is confirmed
given_when_then.when: The actor tries to update profile attributes
given_when_then.then: The system prevents modification and retains the historical record as it existed at the time of archival

given_when_then.given: A Customer Profile is associated with an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The account closure event is initiated
given_when_then.then: The system retains the historical association in the archived Customer Profile

success_criteria: The archived Customer Profile retains all historical data and cannot be modified after the archival action is confirmed.
The system successfully archives the Customer Profile without losing any associated Order Requests or Financial Transaction Records.
The modification timestamp and actor attribution are preserved for the archived Customer Profile state.
The unique identifier of the Customer Profile remains valid and linked to the archived status.
The system does not allow any updates to the Customer Profile after the account closure or significant status change confirmation.
